description: Returns three views of one domain already added to this app (never any other domain): what public DNS shows now — the A, AAAA, CNAME and TXT records at the domain, its www and _gemmein, read from 3 fixed public DNS servers (Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Google (8.8.8.8), Quad9 (9.9.9.9)), with how long each answer is cached and how many of the servers already see each record Gemmein needs; what Gemmein needs for this app; and Gemmein's verdict — whether the domain is proved yours, whether the Live site shows there (connecting, live, needs attention), the secure connection (https), and the one record to change, in plain words and in the DNS provider's own menu terms when the provider is known, with its own guide link. At most one fresh look at public DNS per domain every 5 minutes; a call in between returns the last look and the time the next fresh one can run. Each account has an hourly allowance (30 fresh looks, 10 while the app is in Development only). Each fresh look is on the founder's Logs. When the look sees the ownership record of a domain still waiting to be proved, Gemmein confirms it right there — the same check as the dashboard's Check again — and, for a domain the founder chose to show the Gemmein site at, starts its secure connection; the answer says so (confirmedNow). Gemmein checks a domain that isn't proved yet on its own: every 10 minutes for the first day, then hourly, for 7 days after it was added or last checked by hand; a check by hand (Check again, domain_check, npx gemmein domains) starts the 7 days again. The answer's autoCheck says where the domain is on that schedule. It changes nothing else, and never anything at the DNS provider.
